[*] We've also dedicated efforts to resolve minor environmental bugs, ensuring a seamless and polished gameplay environment. 🌍🐛

Hello demon hunters!

We apologize for the temporary lack of contact from our side. We are constantly working on improvements to the Bloodhound game!

The free retro DLC will be launched in the coming days, there will be a temporary trailer on the store page. We are doing so in order not to delay the publication. In the coming weeks, this trailer will be replaced with a proper one! o7

notes.title: Bloodhound Out Now!
notes.content:
A Nightmarish FPS Experience [b]Now Available on Steam![/b] Descend into the abyss of darkness with Bloodhound, a heart-pounding and visceral first-person shooter that draws inspiration from cult horror movies and chilling real-world locations. The game offers a truly unique experience by blending iconic gameplay mechanics from the horror genre's golden era with our twisted and macabre ideas. Brace yourself for a fast-paced journey through hellish realms, where you seamlessly transition between a distorted reality and an alternate infernal dimension in each harrowing act, confronting your deepest fears in this nightmarish odyssey.

Embrace the darkness and let Bloodhound's macabre world consume you. Dive into the abyss today and experience the thrill of confronting your deepest nightmares. Hurry to [b]claim the launch discount[/b] before it vanishes, and [b]explore the intriguing bundle options[/b] we have in store for you.

See you in HELL!

notes.title: Bloodhound: Unleashing Hell on July 18th!
notes.content:
Kruger & Flint Productions is thrilled to announce that the heart-pounding, adrenaline-fueled horror FPS, Bloodhound, will be hitting Steam for PC on [b]July 18th![/b] Prepare yourself for an intense battle against darkness as you embark on a mission to annihilate the nefarious Cult of Astaroth.

[previewyoutube=e7OwjaWGZEs;full][/previewyoutube]

In Bloodhound, you'll step into the shoes of a valiant member of the Order of Keepers of the Gates, entrusted with the perilous duty of safeguarding the gates of Hell. With your finger on the trigger, navigate through meticulously crafted hellish locations, drawing inspiration from cult horror movies and real-world horrors, and never waver in your quest to vanquish evil.

Prepare to face a myriad of devilish enemies, ranging from demonically nude devil-spawns to terrifying bat-baby hybrids and formidable Hell bosses. Arm yourself with an array of deadly weapons, including machetes, double-barreled shotguns, crossbows, rocket launchers, and even a chainsaw-flamethrower combo. Are you ready to take on the demonic hordes and emerge victorious?

Mark your calendars for [b]July 18th[/b] and gear up to experience the legend of the 90s reborn in Bloodhound. Get ready for an unforgettable battle against darkness that will keep your heart racing and your trigger finger itching for more. Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to unleash hell!

For more information, visit our official Steam page and join our thriving community of demon slayers. Prepare yourself for the ultimate adrenaline rush – [b]Bloodhound is coming[/b], and salvation lies in your hands!

notes.title: Project news and temporary deactivation of the demo
notes.content:
Hello Demon Hunters o/.

Work on the Bloodhound project is in full swing. 

- We've replaced most of the weapon animations,
- We have redesigned the UX and UI along with the Player HUD. 
- We are adding new VFXs, 
- We improved the optimizations even more,
- We added a lot of cool details to the enviroment to make it look even nicer. 
- Our Sound Designers worked on the juiciness of the gun firing.
- We rebalanced weapons and enemies: adding range attacks to some melee enemies
- We have completely redesigned one enemy. Blood Priestess of Astaroth making a purely magic damage character into a supportive damage character. Now the opponents have gained additional support against the player. The priestess seems inconspicuous but left unattended she can mess up a lot during a fight. 
- We have also increased the number of ambients in the game to improve climate building during breaks between fights.
- All the time we are working on improving the AI and its behavior in a group.

As you can see, we are not idle. All the time we are vigorously polishing our beloved project. A large number of changes over the past few months means that we have to temporarily deactivate the demo on Steam. It does not reflect the current technical state. Soon we will also change the library of screenshots and upload a new trailer. 

When we finish work on the 3rd version of the demo. Now the final one. In it you will get to play part of the first act of the game and a lot of other new things. 

We apologize for the silence on our part so far. The work on polishing the project: Bloodhound consumes us completely, so that we are able to forget about the existing world.

Best regards,
Bloodhound team.
From Players to Players o7

notes.title: Early Access and Premiere postponed
notes.content:
Hello Demon Hunters o/

You guys have given us a lot of great and helpful feedback during the Steam demo festival.
Because of it we came to a conclusion that there is a great deal of things we should polish before release.
We decided to change the Early access release date to "As soon as possible", so we can give you the best game we can.
Also the oficial release for PC has been postponed to March 2023 but it will premiere with an Xbox Series X and S ports.
The thought that you like our game and have fun with it is the best motivation to work one could have.


Best regards,
Bloodhound team.
From Players to Players o7

notes.title: Bloodhound on Kickstarter | Try out FREE Demo!
notes.content:
Hi! Hey! Hello! Howdy? HELL yeah! 

Gooooooooooood morning everyone! We would like to welcome everyone to our passion project known as “Bloodhound”! Our game combines gameplay mechanics from the most iconic games of the genre from the 90s and 00s and adds our own fresh ideas to create a unique FPS gameplay experience. But…everyone says so? Aren’t they? So maybe just stop writing and let you play our game! 

[h3]Still here? Bruh – just go and download a FREE demo: [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1935270


[h2]Kickstarter[/h2]

As you may know – or not, we launched a Kickstarter campaign for Bloodhound. This is associated with many factors. Why Kickstarter and what are these factors mentioned earlier? The answers to these questions can be found below.

We created a Kickstarter campaign because we care about building an active community around our project and we are interested in your opinion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42192124/f8acc9ad3cf623b5b97d309292fbf24411d2e396.png[/img]

When creating our game, we assumed that it would have the character of an old-school horror shooter. The feedback we receive from you is very positive. On its basis, we add corrections to the game on an ongoing basis.

We decided to launch a Kickstarter campaign and expand the game with additional activities taking place in the demonic reality of New York, create new opponents, and add more language versions.

Plans for DLC and ports for other platforms were also born. We decided to create two-story expansions and enable the Bloodhound experience for players on Xbox and PlayStation. We also plan a cooperative mode for two players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42192124/d0a35be14e521345007872c7a27ffafb44e3520c.png[/img]

Therefore, in order to provide you with Bloodhound, we are running a Kickstarter campaign during which you will be able to buy the game (at a lower price) and support its development. The game will be created anyway and will be released regardless of the outcome of the campaign but your input can affect potential new features :) 

Our priority is to continue to create a game with you - with the players. Thanks to you, we have noticed new opportunities and new directions. We're improving and modifying the game to give you the best gameplay experience possible.

Bloodhound on Kickstarter:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/knfproductions/bloodhound-shooter]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/knfproductions/bloodhound-shooter[/url]

[h2]STAY UPDATED[/h2]

If you would like to BE UP2DATE with everything about Bloodhound > you can follow & wishlist our game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1926270/Bloodhound/

[h2]Early Access[/h2]
The game will be available in Early Access around June 2022.

Thank you for your support!

[i][b]From players to players,[/b]
Kruger & Flint Production[/i]
